jobs.title: Senior Software Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Technical Project Manager will partner directly with the Senior Director of IT to coordinate, track, and execute technology initiatives. This role drives alignment, structure, and follow-through across projects that span engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations. The ideal candidate is an organized communicator and systems thinker with strong attention to detail, a bias for action, and the ability to work across multiple time zones and teams.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a typical schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Key Responsibilities
(Including, but not limited to, the following):
Coordinate and monitor multiple IT and software development projects.
Build and maintain project schedules, dashboards, and risk logs in Azure DevOps (ADO) and Microsoft 365.
Partner with project managers, developers, and analysts to ensure timelines, scope, and deliverables are clear and tracked.
Summarize project progress, blockers, and next steps for executive reporting.
Manage dependencies across teams (engineering, operations, compliance) and escalate issues early.
Support documentation and governance tracking for audits, release management, and change control.
Lead regular cadence meetings (daily standups, weekly syncs, monthly reviews) to ensure clarity and accountability.
Create structured templates, reports, and tools that help the IT team work efficiently.

Other Duties

Perform such other duties, responsibilities, projects, or assignments as may be assigned by the Company from time to time, provided they are reasonably related to the nature of the position and the Company's business operations.

Qualifications

7+ years of program or project management experience in IT, software, or compliance-heavy environments.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to simplify complex updates.
Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
Experience using Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Power BI.
Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, or cloud-native systems is a plus.
Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and IT governance.
Comfortable working overlapping hours with U.S. leadership and leading teams across time zones.

Preferred

Experience working with engineering teams or in Agile/Scrum environments.
Familiarity with the SDLC, DevOps, or software release processes.
Exposure to tools like Azure DevOps, Jira, or ClickUp.

jobs.title: Project Manager-Bank ATM Installation Program
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend
is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the role

The Project Manager provides consulting services for our financial services client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives. Program consists of new ATM installation for retail bank branches throughout Southeast.

This job is part of the Project Management function responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. The Project Manager will be responsible for installation scheduling and vendor management to ensure program milestones and timelines are met successfully.

What you’ll do

Coordinate project activities among clients, vendors, contractors, technology providers, and operational stakeholders.

Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and implementation plans.

Monitor project progress and ensure milestones, deliverables, and client objectives are achieved.

Interface directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.

Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct a standard request for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.

Implement project documentation governance that is aligned with company and client requirements.

Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely, and coordinated.

Build action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.

Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.

Mentor others and share in-depth knowledge of be responsible for your job subject area and broad understanding of several job fields within the function.

Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with company values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.

Qualifications

What you’ll need

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Bachelor's degree is preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
Experience managing schedules and vendor management required.
Retail bank project/program experience is strongly desired.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) Experience in MS Project or other project management software required.
General knowledge of leases, contracts, construction practices, and the ability to read architectural drawings.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mentality.

Additional Information

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager- Renewable Energy
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager - Project Delivery

Our Mission

The Senior Project Manager - Project Delivery role centers around driving technical and commercial outcomes in pursuit of facility construction. We oversee the construction of projects, working with utilities who connect our projects to the grid, offtakers who purchase our power, and the lenders who finance them. You own the coordination between these parties, you report to the Director of Project Delivery, and you bring our projects online in fulfillment of our obligations, on schedule and within budget. You carry a portfolio of PV and battery storage projects, usually two or three at a time, from origination to Final Completion.

What We Do

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll work as part of a team of engineers, financial professionals, construction experts, and business managers to plan, design, finance, and construct PV Arrays and Battery Energy Storage Systems. Your mandate is facilitating collaboration across Nofar USA's functions and managing budgets and schedules throughout project development, preconstruction, construction, and commissioning. You drive those outcomes the whole way, and you hand the project over at Final Completion.

You'll be at the center of our business workflows, inside and outside the company. You'll work with business development and finance on asset acquisitions, identifying risks and planning how to turn our growth strategy into reality. You'll lead RFPs to procure construction services and purchase critical equipment, and you'll carry those agreements through negotiation and administration. During EPCA turns, you consolidate comments and edits, lead the calls that close them, keep the exhibits and the exhibits tracker in order, and negotiate the statement of values with the counterparty. You'll manage interconnection agreements with the utility and the ISO, and you'll work with finance so procurement and construction information reaches our lenders in a form they can rely on. You'll be the subject matter expert of our execution process, keeping Nofar USA accountable to our PPA counterparties, lenders, and utilities, and keeping our vendors and construction partners accountable to us.

Your job will evolve with the project lifecycle, but you can generally expect to:

Coordinate with EPCs on engineering and construction progress, ensuring that they adhere to the project schedule. Oversee document submittals at key contract milestones. Report progress statistics to senior management during steering committee calls.
Manage budgets, review and approve invoices, move critical project transactions, and work with Nofar USA controls so financial reporting is accurate
Work with engineering and procurement to confirm critical equipment specifications, so the equipment can deliver the power we sold and is bankable
Lead RFPs for construction services and negotiate price and commercial terms
Consolidate EPCA comments and exhibits, lead the calls that close the comments, keep the exhibits tracker current, and negotiate the statement of values through to NTP
Attend meetings with utility companies and manage utility and ISO interconnection agreements against the construction schedule
Work with business development and finance to identify execution risks on acquisitions, and supply the procurement and construction information lenders need
Report PPA milestones, track the schedule risk around those dates, and hold vendors and contractors to what they owe us
Travel to projects and partners for up to 25% of your time, and work remotely the rest
Reconcile the schedule, the cost, and the contract record so that at Final Completion the next team can take the project

Requirements
What We Value

People who are driven to succeed, and who can work with minimal oversight
Detail-oriented people. The tracker, the milestone report, and the budget are useful only when they are right
Opinionated colleagues, willing to say how a project ought to be run
People who are passionate about a career bringing power assets online
People who are comfortable in a growth organization, where the way we work is still being shaped by the people doing the work

What We Require

Remote or Hybrid work, with up to 25% travel
A minimum of three years delivering utility-scale solar or battery storage. Five years is preferred
Required experience in preconstruction, managing budgets, and managing schedules
Preferred experience with PPA milestone management, utility, and ISO interconnection agreements, EPCA negotiation and administration, and working with finance on lender reporting during procurement and construction
We look for degrees in mathematics, statistics, engineering, the sciences, finance, and business. But if you believe you can do this job, we encourage you to apply
Preference will be given to candidates in Fort Lauderdale, FL

Benefits

What We Offer
A Lean Team Where Your Work Actually Matters

We operate with a lean, highly capable team, which means there aren’t layers of people between you and the work that matters. You’ll have real ownership, direct access to decision-makers, and the opportunity to influence how we build and grow the business. If you want to be a meaningful voice rather than a small part of a very large machine, you’ll find that opportunity here.
A Fast Pace and a High Bar

We believe in being transparent about what it’s like to work here: we move quickly, the workload can be demanding, and our expectations are high. This is an environment for people who enjoy being challenged, solving problems, taking initiative, and figuring things out as we grow. In return, you’ll gain exposure, responsibility, and influence that can take years to earn in a more traditional organization.
Who Thrives Here

The people who do best at Blue Sky are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership. They don’t wait to be told what to do next, and they’re willing to step outside the boundaries of a job description when the business needs it. They care about outcomes more than watching the clock, bring solutions instead of simply identifying problems, and genuinely enjoy the energy — and occasional ambiguity — that comes with building a growing company. If you’re a go-getter who wants room to run, you’ll fit in well here.
Benefits That Invest in You

We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance, short-term disability, life insurance, and a 401(k) with a generous 6% company match.
Hybrid, With Purpose

We believe there is real value in being together. Our hybrid model creates regular opportunities for in-person collaboration, faster decision-making, and stronger relationships while still providing flexibility outside of the office.

What to Expect From Our Hiring Process
We’re Choosy — On Purpose.

We fiercely protect the culture we’ve built, and our hiring process reflects that. Skills and experience matter, but so does how you work, how you collaborate, and what you’ll add to the team. We want to get to know the person behind the résumé — and we want you to have plenty of opportunity to get to know us, too.
Our typical hiring process looks like this:
HR Screen → Hiring Manager Interview → Culture Assessment → Case Study, when applicable → Cross-Team Interview → CEO Meet & Greet → Offer

Not every role requires a case study, but for certain positions we use one to better understand how you think, approach problems, and tackle the type of work you would actually be doing here.
It Sounds Like a Lot. It Doesn’t Take a Lot of Time.

We’re deliberate in our hiring decisions, but we’re also decisive. Our average turnaround from initial HR screen to offer is less than two weeks
. We move quickly and respect that candidates have jobs, lives, and other opportunities in motion.
You’ll Always Know Where You Stand.

Clear communication is an important part of our candidate experience. We’ll be transparent about the process and expectations from the beginning, keep you informed as you move through each stage, and close the loop when a decision has been made. We believe every candidate deserves clarity and respect for the time they invest in getting to know us.
We’re intentional about who joins our team because every person on a lean team has an outsized impact. When we make an offer, it’s because we’re genuinely excited about what you can bring to the team.

jobs.description:
About Us

Vault 44.01 (“Vault”) is a leading carbon capture & storage (“CCS”) developer focused on the development, capitalization, and operation of carbon storage assets throughout North America. Vault’s team brings over 90 years of direct carbon storage experience, with involvement in the development of carbon storage projects across North America since 2007.

Vault’s capabilities span technical analysis, project design, permitting, stakeholder engagement, land leasing and acquisition, facility construction, and operations. In collaboration with our industrial partners, we are currently developing CCS projects in the US Midwest, US Southeast, and Canada focusing on single CO2 source, near-site sequestration projects and including 7 projects currently under contract.

Vault has secured a US$300 million equity capital commitment from Grey Rock Investment Partners (Dallas, TX based private equity company) and has offices in Denver, CO and Calgary, AB.

Summary

Start Date: Q1 2027
Job Location: Hybrid/Remote – Calgary strongly preferred - North America/Flexible (Mid-west Region)

Travel required: 4 – 8 + weeks per year depending on home location
Employee Type: Full Time Employee

Opportunity

Vault is currently seeking a Project Manager with subsurface, and operations engineering experience to support and lead the evaluation and development of CCS projects within Vault’s development portfolio. As a key member of the team, the Project Manager will interface with internal and external project participants and stakeholders to lead integrated project development including technical evaluation, budgeting, economic justification, regulatory approval, and execution of projects.

Description Of Role

Evaluate and develop CO2 storage projects:

Manage safe execution of projects within defined scope, schedule, and budget
Demonstrate commitment to safety, including but not limited to project design and operations
Provide engineering technical support (reservoir, drilling, pipeline and/or facility)
Collaborate with multidisciplinary team to evaluate and execute projects
Apply technical and project experience to evaluate project alternatives and effectively manage change
Manage external resources supporting project requirements
Support project economic modeling and sensitivity assessment
Manage project regulatory approval at County, State and Federal levels
Support team with landowner, community, and government relations
Deliver management and partner presentations
Support business development team in identification and capture of new opportunities
Must be legally authorized to work in the USA
Travel to project / partner sites will be required with variable frequency
This position can be remote or hybrid depending on candidate location
Annual salary range is $170,000 to $190,000 depending on ability and experience

Skills And Qualifications

Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Science / Engineering (petroleum, mechanical or chemical preferred) with minimum 10 years of relevant experience in project execution in the upstream oil and gas and/or carbon capture and storage industry
Familiarity with field development (reservoir engineering, geology, drilling/completions and/or fluid dynamics is an asset)
Experience with carbon sequestration or enhanced oil recovery is an asset
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is an asset

Experience with EPA regulations, Class VI permitting process, or CCS-specific regulatory frameworks is an asset
Proven project management skills with previous experience successfully executing projects
Self directed with the ability to collaborate and organize activities from multidiscipline teams

Excellent time management and ability to multitask
Strong analytical skills and business acumen
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Proficient in Office 365 package (skilled in Excel and PowerPoint)
Experience with MS Project, Power BI, ArcGIS considered an asset

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salaries, health and dental coverage, retirement plans, and paid time off to support your work-life balance.

Paid time off and paid holidays
Health & Wellness Account (HSA/WSA)
Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)

jobs.title: Technical Deputy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Lawelawe is a Native Hawaiian Owned Small Disadvantaged Business that provides professional and mission-support services to federal Government customers. We are committed to delivering dependable solutions, supporting our employees, and advancing our mission to uplift economically disadvantaged Native Hawaiian families and preserve Native Hawaiian heritage.

You Are

An experienced technical leader who can manage software development, guide teams, and keep daily program operations moving forward. You bring sound judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex requirements into clear priorities and achievable results. You are comfortable representing Lawelawe with Government customers, corporate leadership, and subcontractors while providing direction and accountability to assigned employees.

How You Will Make An Impact

As the Technical Deputy Program Manager, serving as the Program Manager’s principal deputy and Lawelawe’s senior representative on the contract. Reporting to and supporting the Program Manager, you will guide technical resources, oversee software development from initial design through release, and coordinate Lawelawe personnel and subcontractor support. During planned or unplanned Program Manager absences, you will assume delegated authority for daily program operations to maintain continuity, customer support, and timely delivery.

Responsibilities

Support the Program Manager in directing daily contract operations, coordinating resources, and meeting program objectives.
Serve as acting Program Manager during planned or unplanned absences, exercising delegated authority to maintain operations, customer support, and required deliverables.
Serve as the senior representative and the primary link between Lawelawe corporate leadership and the program team.
Represent Lawelawe; coordinate subcontractor activities, monitor assigned performance, and resolve or escalate staffing and execution issues through established contract channels.
Supervise assigned Lawelawe and Program Management Office (PMO) employees, including workload assignments, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development.
Coordinate hiring activities with Talent Acquisition and address employee relations and corrective actions in coordination with HR.
Guide daily execution across software engineering, development operations, cybersecurity, systems integration, and other applicable technical workstreams.
Translate contractual requirements and agency objectives into technical priorities, requirements, specifications, and executable workflows.
Manage software development projects from design through completion, including analysis, design, development of enhancements and new modules, testing, evaluation, and release.
Partner with the Program Manager and Product Owners to define product strategy, forecast development needs, and plan and execute the product roadmap.
Research product development options and recommend technical approaches and product direction.
Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies and technical governance reviews, providing teams with clear direction, resources, and realistic schedule and cost estimates.
Coordinate deployment of functional improvements within approved release schedules and promote continuous technical improvement.
Partner with the Program Manager to manage scope, schedule, resources, and cost baselines and track performance against contract requirements.
Identify program risks, operational bottlenecks, and engineering issues; implement corrective actions and escalate matters requiring additional authority.
Work with the Program Director, Program Manager, customer, technical leads, and program staff to meet staffing and performance needs.
Coordinate with Government stakeholders, corporate leadership, subcontractors, and program teams to align priorities and resolve technical and operational issues.
Prepare program reports, deliverables, executive briefings, and written updates that clearly communicate technical metrics, progress, risks, and decisions needed.

The Team

Our team brings together program management and technical professionals who work collaboratively to support customer priorities. Department Information

The Polis Center is an applied research center at Indiana University (IU) Indianapolis in the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering. Polis makes data actionable for improving community health, equity, and resilience. We build and use information technology and geographically specific data across a variety of domains and sectors to identify and address our community's most pressing challenges including housing stability, public health, and economic resilience. We are a convener and connector, collaborating with community and academic partners to translate data and research into action. We build capacity in nonprofits, community-based organizations, government, and researchers to use these resources effectively for community good.
From inception, The Polis Center has been guided by core values that include making a difference, collaboration, developing creative solutions to real-world problems, accountability, integrity, respect, and stewardship. We emphasize clarity of roles and shared accountability so that team members can work effectively and independently in service of community based research. Our team is passionate about the work we do, and we love working together. The Polis Center places great value on a positive work/life balance.

The Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Program Manager provides leadership in the development, planning, and implementation of projects related to multi-hazard mitigation planning, flood mapping, GIS data management, crisis informatics research, and more. Provides technical expertise during project planning by assessing GIS requirements, identifying resource needs, and recommending appropriate analytical methods and deliverables

Communicates technical progress, project risks, staffing considerations, and implementation challenges to leadership and project stakeholders, recommending solutions when appropriate
Supports proposal development project planning, and status reporting by providing technical input related to GIS methodologies, staffing estimates, timelines, and project deliverables
Identifies opportunities to improve GIS workflows, technical processes, documentation, and operational efficiency within the GIS team
Develops, maintains, and promotes documentation, standard operating procedures, templates, and technical guidance supporting consistent GIS practices

Promotes continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical consistency across the GIS team to strengthen organizational capacity and service quality
Fosters a collaborative, high-performing team environment

Collaborates with leadership and stakeholders to implement program priorities, coordinate resources, and address operational needs that support program objectives
Communicates operational updates, emerging issues, resource needs, and recommendations to leadership and contributes to planning efforts that strengthen program delivery and team performance

Preferred

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATES

Proficient communication skills

Demonstrates time management and priority setting skills
Demonstrates a high commitment to quality

Experience applying geospatial tools and methods to support hazard mitigation, operations, response, and recovery activities, including conducting spatial analysis and modeling of crises and their impacts on populations

The role requires a rare combination of skills. You need the executive presence to brief and align senior leaders, including the CIO, CFO, Legal, Internal Audit, and Enterprise Risk. You also need the technical fluency to earn credibility with architects, engineers, and scrum teams and to remove their blockers.

Restore service to customers faster
24/7 Security Operations Center; immutable backups; isolated recovery environments; practiced, repeatable recoveries
Make sure each capability is not only built but proven through practice
: recovery exercises, tabletop simulations, and measurable test results.
Turn architecture, standards, and risk priorities into actionable roadmaps, epics, and sprint-level work.

Plan, Execute, and Coordinate Across Teams
Work directly with technology leaders, their managers, and their scrum masters, along with architects and the CISO's teams, to plan and execute the work.
Drive delivery cadence using Agile/Scrum and Lean practices without degrading core business operations or service reliability.
Identify and remove blockers, and resolve cross-team dependencies.
Adapt the plan as needs change and new discoveries arise, such as legacy systems, technical debt, or previously unknown exposures.

Serve as the single operational point of accountability for program status, risks, and dependencies.
Prepare and present Steering Committee updates
to an audience that includes the CIO, CFO, and senior Legal, Internal Audit, and Enterprise Risk leaders.
Maintain program dashboards, risk registers, milestone tracking, and budget and burn-rate reporting.
Define and report metrics that show risk reduction, such as exposed-asset coverage, patch latency, segmentation progress, and recovery time demonstrated in exercises.
Support program budget management (CapEx/OpEx) and the coordination of vendors and third-party delivery partners.

Drive Change and Adoption
Lead change management across business units so that new security controls, identity requirements, and recovery practices are adopted.
Negotiate trade-offs between operational productivity and cyber resilience, always keeping customer service continuity as the priority.
Turn lessons from incidents and exercises into lasting fixes rather than one-time remediations.

Experience:
10+ years of technical program management or security leadership, including at least 5 years directing large-scale security initiatives at Fortune 100 or $10B+ revenue enterprises.
Track record:
Has led a comprehensive security overhaul, cyber resilience program, Zero Trust rollout, or legacy modernization involving distributed engineering teams.
Executive communication:
Has presented to and advised C-suite executives and operated within formal steering committees that include finance, legal, audit, and risk leadership.
Agile delivery:
Hands-on experience working with managers, scrum masters, and architects across multiple teams to plan and deliver complex technical work.
Technical breadth:
Strong working knowledge across:
Identity and Access Management (IAM / PAM / MFA)
External attack surface management, vulnerability management, and automated patching
Network segmentation and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
Security operations (24/7 SOC, EDR / XDR / SIEM / SOAR)
Backup and recovery: immutable backups, isolated recovery environments (cyber vaults), and disaster recovery testing
Cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and secure application standards
Work arrangement:
Based in the United States and able to work on-site 3 days per week.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
CISSP, CISM, PgMP, or PMP certification
Experience with cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience programs, including running live recovery exercises
Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO 27001
Experience in environments with legacy or industrial IT/OT systems

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the role

The Project Manager provides consulting services for our financial services client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives. Program consists of new ATM installation for retail bank branches throughout Southeast.

This job is part of the Project Management function responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. The Project Manager will be responsible for installation scheduling and vendor management to ensure program milestones and timelines are met successfully.

What you’ll do

Coordinate project activities among clients, vendors, contractors, technology providers, and operational stakeholders.

Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and implementation plans.

Monitor project progress and ensure milestones, deliverables, and client objectives are achieved.

Interface directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.

Build action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.

Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.

Mentor others and share in-depth knowledge of be responsible for your job subject area and broad understanding of several job fields within the function.

Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with company values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.

Qualifications

What you’ll need

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Bachelor's degree is preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
Experience managing schedules and vendor management required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) Experience in MS Project or other project management software required.

About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies all across the world navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will be responsible for end-to-end project life cycle management. The Senior Project Manager works with all stakeholders in building and growing client relationships and handling escalated issues appropriately.

Serves as the main point of contact for the customer and the Coalfire team throughout the project

Prepare project plans for all phases of the project or program with appropriate level of detail

Work with Resource Deployment Managers to secure resources to achieve project objectives in planned timeframe

Demonstrates ability to manage a high-volume portfolio while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and moving work forward efficiently

Skilled at keeping pace with large accounts involving multiple moving parts

Closely work with engagement lead to manage the day-to-day activities and resources on project engagements

Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership

Understand interdependencies between technology, operations, and business needs

Responsible for project scope, budget, timelines, communication, and change management

Set and continually manage project expectations and risks while delegating and managing deliverable with project team members and stakeholders

Monitor, track and control issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables. Escalates issues when necessary and follows escalation through to resolution

Develop and deliver progress reports, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, and key stakeholders

Work with a team of matrixed employees to deliver a succinct customer experience

Ensure that projects and programs are proceeding according to established quality standards

Understand project management principles, methods, and techniques

Effectively applies Coalfire methodology and enforces project standards. Provides feedback on process changes and improvements

Perform other duties as assigned

Maintains company defined billable utilization targets

What You'll Bring

Minimum of 5 years of project management experience

Minimum of 3 years experience working in a client facing, consulting environment

Minimum of 3 years experience managing cybersecurity and/or penetration testing engagements

Bachelor's Degree or associate degree plus equivalent experience in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field of study

Able to structure and lead cross-functional teams and stakeholders through the full life cycle of projects

Demonstrated understanding of Project Management methodology: including waterfall and agile methodologies

Proven success managing several projects simultaneously

Experience creating, adapting, or updating project management governance and processes for a centralized PMO 

Demonstrated project ownership and consistent delivery on commitments

At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.

You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Defense Programs
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a Program Manager to lead assigned Department of Defense programs and related defense contracts. This role will own day-to-day program performance, including cost, schedule, customer commitments, technical coordination, and overall contract execution. The Sr. Program Manager will be the primary customer interface and the internal lead for keeping programs on track. This requires close coordination with engineering, software, supply chain, contracts, finance, quality, security, and logistics support teams. This is a hands-on program leadership role. The right candidate will be comfortable bringing structure to complex work, driving decisions across functional teams, and addressing issues before they turn into customer or financial problems.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Own assigned program performance including cost, schedule, contract commitments, customer satisfaction, and delivery results.
Lead the regular operating rhythm for programs including team meetings, program reviews, risk reviews, action tracking, and leadership updates.
Serve as the primary customer point of contact for assigned programs.
Manage customer expectations and make sure contractual commitments are understood, tracked, and met.
Turn contract requirements, Statement of Work (SOW) language, Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs), Contract Data Requirement Lists (CDRLs), deliverables, milestones, and customer commitments into practical program plans.
Develop and maintain program schedules, budgets, staffing plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and recovery plans.
Track program financial performance including funding status, burn rate, actuals, forecasts, Estimate to Complete (ETC) / Estimate at Completion (EAC) inputs, revenue, margin, and cash flow impacts.
Identify risks, issues, and performance gaps early and drive corrective action when programs move off plan.
Coordinate work across engineering, software, supply chain, contracts, finance, quality, security, and logistics support functions.
Work with Supply Chain, Subcontracts, Engineering, and Quality to manage subcontractor and supplier performance.
Support contract negotiations, modifications, Request for Equitable Adjustments (REAs), Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), and scope changes in coordination with Contracts, Finance, Engineering, and executive leadership.
Ensure program work stays aligned with contract requirements, company procedures, quality standards, security requirements, and applicable DoD regulations.
Prepare and present program status, financial performance, risks, staffing needs, corrective actions, and decision points to senior leadership and customer stakeholders.
Support proposal and capture activities, including technical volume inputs, Basis of Estimates (BOEs), schedule development, risk inputs, basis of estimate reviews, and transition planning.
Help identify follow-on opportunities, customer needs, contract growth areas, and lessons learned.
Build a team environment that is organized, accountable, and focused on delivery.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, management, or a related field strongly preferred.
5-8+ years of relevant experience in program management, project management, engineering program leadership, defense operations, or a related field with 5+ years supporting or managing U.S. Government or DoD contracts.
Experience managing program cost, schedule, customer communications, technical coordination, risks, issues, and corrective actions.
Experience executing Department of Defense (DoD) contracts in a Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) / Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) environment, including one or more contract types or vehicles such as Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF), Time & Materials (T&M), Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Other Transaction Authority (OTA), prototype, production, sustainment, or services contracts.
Experience managing contract execution elements such as SOW/Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements, CLINs, CDRLs, deliverables, milestones, funding, and change control.
Ability to monitor and explain program financial performance, including budget, actuals, forecasts, funding status, burn rate, ETC/EAC inputs, revenue, margin, and cash flow impacts.
Experience coordinating subcontractor, supplier, or vendor performance in support of program objectives.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

The Senior Data Analyst (EUTS) is a hands-on analytics leader responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing Power BI–based dashboards, reports, and data products that illuminate trends across End User Services (Service Desk, Deskside/Field, EUC engineering, collaboration, and device management). The role blends data engineering (SQL, APIs, scripting) with data visualization and storytelling, turning diverse operational data into actionable insights that improve front-line IT support, elevate the employee experience, and standardize contractual reporting (SLAs/KPIs). Success requires deep Business Intelligence expertise, strong stakeholder engagement, and a passion for transforming the end-user landscape through data-driven decisions.

Design and deliver BI solutions: Build scalable Power BI semantic models, datasets, and interactive dashboards (DAX/M, row-level security) that provide real-time visibility into ticket volumes, backlog, MTTR, first-contact resolution, CSAT, SLA adherence, and overall operational performance across End User Services.
Operational reporting and standardization: Establish a single, governed reporting framework for contractual commitments—SLAs, OLAs, KPIs—and produce consistent monthly/quarterly executive and vendor reports, including variance analysis and trend diagnostics.
Data engineering and integration: Create robust data pipelines using SQL and scripting (PowerShell/Python) to ingest and transform data from systems such as ServiceNow/Jira, Microsoft 365, Intune/Endpoint analytics, SCCM/MECM, Azure Log Analytics, and other operational tools via REST/Graph APIs.
Decision support for front-line IT: Translate findings into practical recommendations that improve front-end IT support (knowledge gaps, training opportunities, shift-left opportunities, automation candidates, problem management themes) and track the impact of those actions.
Quality, governance, and reliability: Implement data quality checks, documentation, and version control; define source-of-truth datasets and KPIs with clear business definitions; ensure access, security, and RLS align with company policy.
Self-service enablement: Publish certified datasets, Power BI apps, and report templates; coach End User Services teams on interpreting visuals and using insights in daily stand-ups and service reviews.
Automation and scale: Automate refresh, distribution, and alerts (e.g., SLA breach notifications, anomaly detection, threshold exceptions) to reduce manual reporting time.
Executive storytelling: Craft concise narratives for senior leadership, connecting metrics to outcomes (experience, productivity, cost, risk), and present insights in QBRs/MBRs.
Collaboration: Partner with Service Desk & Deskside leads, EUC engineering, Collaboration/M365, Vendor Management, Finance, PMO, and InfoSec to align data definitions, priorities, and roadmaps.

Required Qualifications
5–8+ years in Data Analytics/BI with measurable impact in IT service management or end-user computing environments.
Expert with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query/M, row-level security, Power BI Service/Apps, deployment pipelines).
Advanced SQL across enterprise platforms (e.g., SQL Server/Azure SQL) and strong Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas).
Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell and/or Python) to automate data ingestion, transformation, and report operations.
Demonstrated experience consuming REST/Graph APIs for data extraction (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph, Intune, Microsoft 365, Jira).
Proven track record building SLA/KPI frameworks and operational dashboards that drive behavior change in IT support organizations.
Strong data visualization best practices and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling stories for technical and non-technical audiences.
Familiarity with ITIL concepts (Incident, Problem, Change) and metrics such as MTTA/MTTR, first contact resolution, backlog aging, ticket deflection, and CSAT.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300); plus nice-to-have: DP-900/DP-203 or Azure data certifications.
ITIL® Foundation certification.
Experience with ServiceNow reporting, Power Platform (Power Automate), and scheduled/parameterized content (subscriptions, paginated reports).

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Integrated Data Services (IDS) is a leading provider of custom software products and Government financial management services. IDS was founded in 1997 in El Segundo, CA, and since that time has seen tremendous growth and success. Currently IDS has offices supporting customers nationwide. By providing customers with fast, efficient and reliable information systems and support services, IDS has become a preferred provider of financial and programmatic systems, services, and solutions across a wide variety of government agencies. Position Description:

IDS is seeking an ambitious self-starter to provide data analytics support for our government customers. This position will work with senior leadership to perform data extraction, cleansing, analysis, visualization and storytelling. Successful candidates will have experience analyzing data from Air Force systems (Finance, Logistics, Personnel, Acquisition, Contracting, etc.), work well in a collaborative environment, think creatively, thrive under pressure, and be able to adjust to shifting priorities quickly. Candidates will possess effective diplomatic, time management, and oral and written communication skills. This position will serve as a hybrid Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Business Data Analyst (BDA) role. The SME will provide expertise in Strategic Resource Management (SRM), a tool that allows organizations to optimize resource manpower requirements by function, location, and fiscal year. The individual will build visualizations that utilize manpower, resource, and associated risk-based tiering of program data. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Gather business requirements, analyze source systems, define underlying data sources and transformation requirements, design data models, and develop metadata for data analysis and visualization

Acquire and analyze data and metrics across the enterprise to learn how they can be incorporated into data visualizations and dashboards

Collaborate with business areas and project teams to elicit, identify, prioritize, and document data visualization and business intelligence requirements

Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert

Translate business analysis and business needs into prototypes concepts of reports and dashboards and contribute to design and visualization best practices

Utilize business intelligence tools to take dashboard requirements and develop deliverable solutions

Document data acquisition, data management and data governance processes

Make and implement process improvements and efficiencies

Create training materials and user guides

Conduct group and one-on-one training sessions with end users

Otherwise Support a Government Financial Office Knowledge And Skills

Minimum of ten (10) years of human resources and manpower experience within a Department of War organization.

Deep knowledge of manpower business processes developed through leadership roles.

Candidates with experience using Business Intelligence (BI) and self-service data visualization tools such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Qlik View and HR skills are highly preferred.

Experience with Strategic Resource Management (SRM) and Resource Identification Tool (RIT) is preferred. Education and Work Experience:

This position requires a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business management, engineering, computer science, mathematics, accounting, economics or other related discipline.

Qualifications

Experience in lieu of education may be considered if the individual has fourteen (14) or more years of relevant experience. Physical & Mental Qualifications:

Must be able to sit, type, hear, see, and speak for extended periods of time.

Must consistently work and type on a computer for prolonged periods of time.

Must be able to communicate accurate information and ideas so others will understand.

Must be able to lift/carry at least 15 lbs.

May be required to move about inside an office to access file cabinets, office supplies, etc. Security Clearance:

Some Travel May Be Required. Hours

Applicants selected for employment will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet additional eligibility requirements for access to classified information or materials. Travel:

Required

Normal work schedule hours may vary, Monday through Friday. May be required to work additional hours and/or weekends, as needed, to meet deadlines or to fulfill travel obligations. Salary Range:

$90,000 - $130,000 per year

jobs.title: [Disney Dreamlight Valley PC/Console] Analyste de données sénior - Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Description du poste

Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Analyste de données senior pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme !

Rempli de quêtes, d'exploration et d'activités captivantes avec des personnages emblématiques de Disney et Pixar, Disney Dreamlight Valley est une production originale de Gameloft Montréal créée par une équipe passionnée impatiente de vous accueillir !

Votre mission

Relevant du Live Ops Studio Lead, vous serez la référence analytique de l'équipe. Vous contribuerez directement aux décisions stratégiques du jeu grâce à des analyses approfondies, tout en accompagnant la croissance de l'équipe analytique. Votre rôle consistera également à préparer les fondations analytiques d'un nouveau projet, faire évoluer nos outils et processus, et intégrer les nouvelles technologies, notamment l'IA, afin d'accroître l'impact de la donnée au sein du studio.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

Agir comme expert(e) de la donnée pour Disney Dreamlight Valley en développant une compréhension approfondie du jeu, de son économie et de l'écosystème analytique de Gameloft
Encadrer une analyste de données junior et contribuer à son développement professionnel à travers le mentorat, la révision d'analyses et le partage des meilleures pratiques
Préparer la stratégie analytique d'un nouveau titre, incluant la définition des KPIs, des plans de tracking et des outils de suivi nécessaires à sa croissance future
Réaliser des analyses avancées sur le comportement des joueurs, la rétention, la monétisation, la segmentation et la performance des fonctionnalités afin d'orienter les décisions Live Ops
Concevoir et évaluer des tests A/B complexes, transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes et communiquer les principaux enseignements aux équipes de production et à la direction
Améliorer continuellement les pipelines de données, les processus analytiques, l'automatisation du reporting ainsi que l'utilisation des outils d'intelligence artificielle au sein de l'équipe

Ce que vous accomplirez

Dans les 3 premiers mois

Développer une compréhension approfondie de Disney Dreamlight Valley, des objectifs Live Ops et de l'écosystème de données Gameloft
Prendre en charge les analyses stratégiques du jeu et établir une relation de confiance avec les principales parties prenantes
Identifier les premières opportunités d'amélioration des processus et contribuer à la préparation analytique du nouveau titre

Dans les 6 premiers mois

Devenir la référence analytique de l'équipe pour les enjeux de rétention, d'engagement et de croissance
Mettre en place des améliorations significatives aux pipelines, aux outils et aux méthodes de travail
Accompagner activement la progression de l'analyste junior et contribuer à l'adoption de nouvelles pratiques basées sur l'IA

Dans les 12 premiers mois

Définir et influencer la feuille de route analytique de l'équipe Live Ops
Jouer un rôle clé dans la croissance de Disney Dreamlight Valley et dans la préparation analytique des futurs projets du studio
Être reconnu(e) comme un partenaire stratégique de confiance auprès des équipes de production et de la direction

Avec qui vous travaillerez

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le Live Ops Studio Lead, l'équipe de production de Disney Dreamlight Valley, les équipes BI et Data, ainsi qu'avec les principaux décideurs du studio.

Le parcours de recrutement

Entrevue recruteur
Test technique
Entrevue avec l’équipe
Entrevue finale avec les managers

Les perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste représente une occasion unique de contribuer à la stratégie de l'un des plus importants projets de Gameloft tout en développant des compétences en leadership, en analytique avancée et en stratégie produit. Il offre également la possibilité d'évolution vers un rôle de lead.

***

Gameloft Montreal is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the team working on Disney Dreamlight Valley, a cross-platform hybrid life-sim/adventure game!

Filled with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring iconic Disney and Pixar characters, Disney Dreamlight Valley is an original Gameloft Montreal production created by a passionate team eager to welcome you!

Your mission

Reporting to the Live Ops Studio Lead, you will serve as the team's go-to analytics expert. You will directly influence game strategy through in-depth analysis while helping grow the analytics function within the team. Your role will also involve laying the analytical foundations for a new project, evolving our tools and processes, and leveraging emerging technologies, including AI, to maximize the impact of data across the studio.

What your day-to-day will look like

Act as the data expert for Disney Dreamlight Valley by developing a deep understanding of the game, its economy, and Gameloft’s analytics ecosystem
Mentor a Junior Data Analyst and support their professional growth through coaching, analysis reviews, and knowledge sharing
Prepare the analytics strategy for a new title, including KPI definitions, tracking plans, and reporting tools required to support its future growth
Perform advanced analyses related to player behavior, retention, monetization, segmentation, and feature performance to support Live Ops decision-making
Design and evaluate complex A/B tests, translate findings into actionable recommendations, and communicate key insights to production teams and leadership
Continuously improve data pipelines, analytical processes, reporting automation, and the adoption of AI-powered tools within the team

What you'll accomplish

Within your first 3 months

Develop a deep understanding of Disney Dreamlight Valley, Live Ops objectives, and Gameloft’s data ecosystem.
Take ownership of the game's strategic analyses and build trusted relationships with key stakeholders.
Identify initial opportunities to improve processes and contribute to the analytical preparation of a new title.

Within your first 6 months

Become the team's go-to analytics expert on retention, engagement, and growth-related topics.
Implement meaningful improvements to pipelines, tools, and ways of working.
Actively support the development of the Junior Data Analyst and contribute to the adoption of AI-driven practices.

Within your first 12 months

Define and influence the Live Ops analytics roadmap.
Play a key role in the growth of Disney Dreamlight Valley and the analytical preparation of future studio projects.
Be recognized as a trusted strategic partner by production teams and studio leadership.

Who you’ll work with

You will work closely with the Live Ops Studio Lead, the Disney Dreamlight Valley production team, BI and Data teams, as well as key decision-makers across the studio.

Recruitment process

Recruiter Interview
Technical Test
Team Interview
Final Interview with the Hiring Managers

Growth opportunities

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the strategy of one of Gameloft's most important projects while developing expertise in leadership, advanced analytics, and product strategy. It also provides a clear path for growth into a Lead role.

Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir

SQL et Python de niveau expert; conception et optimisation de pipelines de données; maîtrise d'un outil de visualisation (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
Expertise en analyses multidimensionnelles (cohortes, segmentation, prédictif) et en tests A/B
Capacité à mettre en place des pipelines, standards et bonnes pratiques à partir de zéro, et à en mesurer l'efficacité
Usage régulier des outils d'IA et veille active sur les technologies émergentes (IA/ML)
Grande autonomie et sens de l'initiative; capacité à mener plusieurs projets en parallèle et à composer avec l'ambiguïté

Votre profil

5 ans et plus d'expérience en analyse de données, idéalement dans le jeu vidéo (F2P / live service), avec un baccalauréat en mathématiques, statistiques, économie, informatique ou domaine connexe
Expérience concrète de mentorat; capacité à faire monter en compétence toute l'équipe
Talent pour transformer les données en récits stratégiques et influencer les décisions, jusqu'à la direction
Atout : expérience d'un lancement de jeu, de la préproduction au live
Maîtrise de l'anglais (oral et écrit), esprit d'équipe et passion pour les jeux vidéo

***

What you need to succeed

Expert SQL and Python; designs and optimizes data pipelines; proficiency with a visualization tool (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
Expertise in multi-dimensional analyses (cohort, segmentation, predictive) and A/B testing.
Ability to build pipelines, standards and best practices from scratch, and to measure their effectiveness
Regular use of AI tools and active watch on emerging technologies (AI/ML)
Highly autonomous self-starter; able to run several projects in parallel and handle ambiguity

Your profile

5+ years of data analysis experience, ideally in games (F2P / live service), with a Bachelor's degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or a related field
Hands-on mentoring experience; able to raise the whole team's capabilities
Talent for turning data into strategic narratives and influencing decisions, up to leadership.
Nice to have: experience launching a game, from pre-production to live
Fluent in English (written and spoken), team-oriented, and passionate about video games

Informations supplémentaires

Ce en quoi Gameloft croit :

Nous jouons le jeu pour un monde meilleur. En tant que leader dans l'industrie, nous voulons utiliser le pouvoir des jeux vidéos comme une force positive au changement.

En nous rejoignant, vous aurez une multitudes d'opportunités pour aider votre environnement, faire la différence et bâtir un monde plus inclusif.

Nous voulons que les Gamelofteurs se concentrent sur l'essentiel: créer du fun et des jeux de haute qualité dont ils pourront être fiers de les partager avec les joueurs du monde entier.

Pour vous aider dans votre rôle, nous avons mis en place les bénéfices suivants:

Ce que nous offrons :

Horaire flexible
Vendredi après-midi de congé toute l’année!
Dès votre embauche, 3 semaines de vacances et des congés mobiles
Congé offert entre Noël et le jour de l'An pour bien débuter la nouvelle année
Programme de REER collectif avec participation de l'employeur
Programme d'assurances collectives avantageux
Accès gratuit à une clinique médicale virtuelle 24h/24, 7 jours/7
Programme d'aide aux employés et à leur famille immédiate
Programme de remboursement partiel pour votre déplacement au bureau (transport en commun et/ou stationnement)
Accompagnement lors de toute relocalisation pour les nouveaux collaborateurs en provenance de pays ou de régions hors Québec
Programme de référencement avec bonus
Activités et prix offerts régulièrement par le comité social

Mais aussi au studio :

Local à vélos sécurisé et montant offert pour encourager le transport actif (période estivale)
Collations offertes quotidiennement (fruits, café, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About Marktplaats

Marktplaats is one of the Netherlands' leading online marketplaces, helping make commerce more sustainable by giving products an extended life. With over 2.1 million buyers and sellers visiting our platform every day, around 350,000 new listings added daily and users spending an average of 22 minutes per visit, we're building a platform that people use and trust. Every connection we enable helps people save money, earn money and reduce waste. As part of Adevinta, one of Europe's leading online classifieds groups, we're building products that make buying and selling second-hand products simpler, safer and better for everyone.

This role sits within our Product & Technology function in our Amsterdam office, home to over 300 talented professionals, where cross-functional teams design, develop and scale the products that millions of users rely on every day across our Benelux marketplaces, Marktplaats and 2dehands/2ememain.

Our teams are multi-functional, bringing together product managers, UX designers, developers, marketers and analysts. The Analytics team supports them by fostering a data-driven mindset, uncovering opportunities and enabling informed decisions across product, business and marketing. You will help answer questions like: What matters most to buyers when purchasing a car? How can we increase conversion and customer lifetime value? Which marketing channels truly drive incremental growth?

What You Will Do

Partner with product managers, commercial leads and marketers to understand their goals and the business context behind their requests, then turn them into an analytical agenda that drives real decisions
Spot opportunities and risks before they're raised: drops in conversion, shifts in monetisation, changes in competitive positioning and emerging user behaviour, from how buyers search to what makes a listing convert
Build dashboards and reports that tell a clear story, not just display numbers, centred on the KPIs that matter for revenue, retention and growth, and decide whether a dashboard, a deeper analysis or an experiment is the right tool
Work with large-scale, complex datasets (TB-level, nested, distributed) in SQL, Python and Databricks to extract signal from noise, and measure things like incremental marketing impact, customer lifetime value and user satisfaction with new offers
Communicate findings to influence decisions at every level, from a squad's weekly review to a leadership strategy discussion
Partner with data, product and engineering teams to improve data quality, tracking, event modelling, metric definitions and documentation, so stakeholders can trust the numbers

The challenge
: Turning vague, ambiguous business questions into focused analyses that lead to action, while strengthening how data is captured, modelled and defined (tracking, event modelling, metrics), so stakeholders can trust the numbers behind their decisions.

Who You Are

8+ years in analytics, ideally in a product-led digital business such as a marketplace or e-commerce
A degree in statistics, computer science, econometrics, economics or a related quantitative field
Expert SQL (nested structures, window functions, query optimisation) and Python for analysis, modelling and automation, with code others can build on
Hands-on experience with Databricks, BigQuery, AWS or equivalent, and familiarity with dbt, Airflow or similar tools
Proficiency with Tableau or similar BI tools, and practical experience with Google Analytics 4
A solid grasp of marketplace revenue drivers: monetisation, funnel economics, customer lifetime value and acquisition vs. retention trade-offs
A track record of turning ambiguous business questions into clear analytical plans, and of influencing decisions by reframing weak questions, not just answering them
Strong communication: you can explain a regression discontinuity design to an engineer and a revenue impact to a VP
Curiosity about user behaviour: what makes a buyer trust a seller, what makes a listing convert, what keeps users coming back

Bonus Points

Experience in classifieds, two-sided marketplaces or platforms with both consumer and commercial revenue streams.

Our Tech Stack

Language: SQL, Python
Database: Databricks, BigQuery
Cloud: AWS
Other tools: Tableau, Google Analytics 4, dbt, Airflow

This role is based out of our Amsterdam
office. While we offer flexibility, we value in-person collaboration and encourage our teams to spend regular time in the office.

Want to learn more about life at Marktplaats? Visit our Careers page to explore our culture, benefits and what it's like to work with us.

Our DNA

Our culture is built on these five principles, shaping how we work together, build products and create value for our customers.

🛠️ Ownership
: We take ownership, step in where needed and make things happen.

🤝 Engagement
: We show up for each other, build meaningful connections, celebrate success and enjoy the ride together.

: We put our customers at the heart of our decisions, back our ideas with data and deliver value that makes a difference.

⚡ Execution
: We move with purpose, challenge ideas respectfully, act with confidence and deliver at pace.

💡 Curiosity
: We ask questions, challenge the status quo, embrace learning and turn insights into better decisions.

jobs.title: PROJECT MANAGER-Automated Synthesis Facility
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Scripps Research is a nonprofit biomedical institute ranked as one of the most influential in the world for its impact on innovation. We celebrated our 100-year legacy in 2024. This significant milestone marks a century of seminal discoveries in immunology, infectious diseases (such as COVID-19, flu, HIV), neuroscience, heart disease, cancer, and more. Located in La Jolla, California, the institute houses six research departments, multiple Nobel laureates, a top-ranked graduate school and a leading postdoctoral training program. Scripps Research encompasses two elite and highly innovative institutes, the Calibr-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines and Scripps Research Translational Institute, which merge foundational studies in biology, chemistry and computer science with translational science to produce pioneering drugs and advances in digital and precision medicine. Together, we cultivate new scientific leaders and expand the frontiers of knowledge to deliver medical breakthroughs impacting human health around the globe. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team.
POSITION TITLE:
 Project Manager
POSITION SUMMARY: 

The Automated Synthesis Facility (ASF) at Scripps Research hosts the Chemistry Node of the U.S. National Science Foundation Programmable Cloud Laboratory (PCL) Test Bed, a four-year NSF Cooperative Agreement. The Node is turning ASF from a supervised shared-use facility into a remotely accessible, closed-loop, AI-driven chemistry platform: instruments exposed through open standardized interfaces, experiments planned and refined by machine-learning models, and results captured against FAIR-compliant metadata schemas. The work spans three institutions: Scripps Research, UCLA, and Sunthetics, Inc. with several institutional and industrial partners.
We are looking for a full-time Project Manager to serve as the Node’s dedicated project management professional. Working with the Principal Investigator/Node Director, the Project Manager assists in managing the budget, schedule, and scope of the award; drives the Node against NSF’s fixed implementation gates; leads reporting to NSF; and coordinates the Node’s role in Test Bed-wide governance, standards development, and user recruitment. The position is named Node-level Key Personnel under the award’s Cooperative Agreement Programmatic Terms and Conditions and sits on the Node Management Team. The role is a fixture of both operations: approximately 90% of effort supports the NSF award, with the balance supporting day-to-day administration of the Automated Synthesis Facility.
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES:

Assist the Node Director in managing the budget, schedule, and scope of the project, including expenditures against the approved budget, subaward invoicing and deliverables (UCLA; Sunthetics, Inc.), and coordination with the Scripps’ Office of Sponsored Programs and financial teams.
Maintain the Strategic Implementation Plan and Project Execution Plan (PEP) as living documents and keep the Instrument Inventory Table current in a form satisfying 2 CFR §200.313 equipment use requirements.
Drive execution against the PCL Implementation Timeline — Alpha (≤12 months), Beta (≤18 months), Robust User Service (≤24 months), and Post-Award Continued Operation (≤48 months) — maintaining the Node risk register and surfacing schedule risk early for re-planning with the Node Director.
Lead reporting to NSF: quarterly project reports (quarterly in year one, thereafter as requested by the cognizant Program Officer) plus annual and final reports via Research.gov, covering timeline progress, cross-node standards, workshop outcomes and user onboarding, research security and safety, and data and AI operations.
Provide project management support to the Node Executive Committee and the three Technical Integration Working Groups: set agendas, coordinate the biweekly integration and Science Driver meetings and the monthly all-hands, and track decisions and action items to closure.
Coordinate instrumentation procurement, installation, and vendor engineering engagements with the Node Director, vendor project teams, ASF staff, and institutional Facilities and Environmental Health & Safety.
Coordinate cross-node and NSF-facing engagement: Test Bed working groups on protocols, instrument validation, metadata standards, and AI model practices; site and reverse-site reviews; and the annual in-person PCL PI meeting, including logistics for the meeting the Node hosts.
Facilitate communication across a distributed technical team — ASF staff, academic co-Investigators, industrial AI/ML engineers, and instrument vendors — and between the Node, its users, and the cognizant NSF Program Officer.
Coordinate Recruitment and On-Boarding Workshops and the user-access pipeline, including solicitation, the feasibility and alignment review with the User Access Committee, and tracking of safety, export-control, and responsible-AI onboarding requirements.
Track and report Node metrics — operational robustness, scientific impact, and structured user-satisfaction surveys — maintain the response strategy for user requests and run the quarterly continuous-improvement cycle.
Support compliance and administrative requirements of the Cooperative Agreement, including Key Personnel prior-approval notifications, participant-support cost handling, Build America Buy America and CHIPS and Science Act §10636 provisions, Bayh-Dole and knowledge-sharing agreements, and NSF acknowledgement and brand standards.
Maintain project documentation and version-controlled records and keep current the Node’s public-facing information on capabilities, onboarding, reproducibility practices, and training materials.
ASF facility administration (approximately 10% of effort).
Support day-to-day operation of the Automated Synthesis Facility alongside the Node: user billing and recharge through Idea Elan Infinity, purchase-order reconciliation and laboratory ordering, travel coordination for the ASF/Node Director, and correspondence with ASF external partners and service clients.

REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Biology, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or equivalent qualification , as required by the award’s Cooperative Agreement Programmatic Terms and Conditions.
Minimum of four years’ experience in project management and/or leadership, coordinating scientists and engineers to develop technical solutions to scientific problems.
Demonstrated experience managing budget, schedule, and scope on a multi-institutional project, tracking deliverables, progress, and metrics against a defined roadmap and work plan.

jobs.description:
A2LA is a non-profit, public service membership organization offering compliance and accreditation services to organizations all over the world. A2LA is dedicated to formally recognizing testing, calibration and other laboratories and related organizations for their quality and technical competency with a variety of international standards (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO/IEC 17020, etc.), federal requirements (FDA, GLP, FCC, etc.), state (cannabis, etc.), and local requirements (water testing, etc.).

Whether it is the clean air that you breathe, the water you drink, or the vehicle you drive, A2LA helps make the world a better, safer place by working to ensure that organizations are releasing products and services that are meeting testing and quality standards. Detailed information about our services can be found on our website at https://www.a2la.org/about.

The Role

A2LA is seeking a committed professional to assist in the day-to-day accreditation operations for the Product Certification program. The responsibility of the Product Certification Program Manager will be to monitor processes, procedures, and applicable standards concerning the Product Certification program. This position serves to ensure the quality and competency of all conformity assessment bodies (CABs) under the program.

About You

You are a technically focused individual with strong multitasking skills. You have proven excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills. You can manage your time effectively and adapt to changing priorities. You are a self-motivated individual who is dedicated to the success of the program.

Responsibilities

Oversee the accreditation process of CABs for ISO/IEC 17065.
Serve as a main point of contact in product certification for all routine and non-routine inquiries.
Perform assessor over-sites in the Product Certification area.
Proactively manage all aspects of the assigned accreditation program, such as ensuring that program documents and forms are current, and relevant association website sections are current.
Represent and participate in relevant industry groups (e.g., EPA ENERGYSTAR, TCB, etc.) as an accreditation expert.
Act as a liaison for external regulators and other organizations associated with the assigned program.
Develop and implement new growth strategy for the Product Certification program.
Train staff and prospective assessors to the ISO/IEC 17065 standard.
Collaborate with shared services to develop, maintain, and implement business plans targeting Product Certification program growth.
Responsible for revision and/or development of external documents for international involvement of specific Product Certification conformity activities related to ISO/IEC 17065.

A2LA may provide exceptions to educational requirements for veterans who demonstrate the ability to perform the duties listed in this job posting.

Requirements

A successful candidate for this position typically meets the following criteria:

Minimum of Bachelor's degree in a scientific field of study.
10 years of product certification technical experience.
An understanding and implementation of relevant conformity assessment standards.
Experience with International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and Standards Developing Organizations (SDOs).
Experience with assessing (or auditing) including principles, techniques, and application of requirements.
Evidence of strong internal/external customer service orientation.
Proven leadership skills.
Advanced computer proficiency (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).
Some travel will be required.

The salary for this position is commensurate with experience. The wage range is $70,000-90,000 annually. In addition, A2LA offers a robust 403(b) retirement plan and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA (medical and dependent), life insurance, short- and long-term disability, employee assistance program (EAP), AFLAC, tuition reimbursement and other pre-taxed benefits, paid-time off, 10 paid government holidays, 1 floating holiday, training and development, career advancement opportunities and much more!
